title: Smart Monitoring Device
description: device schema for smart monitoring device

worker.description: Information of workers wearing device, including the worker's unique identification ID, the worker's name, and mobile phone number.

workerName.description: Name of the worker (e.g., John Doe).

additionalProperties.description: Additional properties about the smart monitoring device, including cicSiteId and remark

cicSiteId.description: A unique site ID provided by CIC, and it is recommended to include it for future data exchange.

remark.description: Additional notes about the smart monitoring device (e.g., In use).
